title: 1.3.3 is almost here
body: 1.3.3 is basically done and in testing right now. Hip fire on the crosshair, scopes that pan, auto aim with modern controls, mouse and gamepad together, mouse in menus, Siberia shake fixed, VU1 setup error fixed and setup for older CPUs. Release in the next hours if the tests look good.

title: Why widescreen is the hard part, and where we are
body: In 4:3 the game runs as it was made. Native widescreen means adjusting every 4:3 spot by hand. Fixed: MapMaker editor, Linux setup, hip fire crosshair, jitter with V-Sync, scopes on controller. Thank you for every report!

title: Devlog: the full Crystal Cut polish list
body: We went through every report again, open and closed. Graphics and widescreen first, then aiming, gameplay, setup and performance. All of it gets fixed and tested against the original before the next update.

title: Back to work: polish first, no new features
body: Work is back on. No new features until everything in the game runs properly. Graphics bugs first, then aiming and gameplay, every fix tested before the next update.

title: Devlog: what we're working on and what could come
body: MapMaker tile placement in widescreen, the level select texture glitch, mouse and controller at the same time, more widescreen spots, co-op cutscenes, and ideas like a cinema mode and public online servers.

title: Crystal Cut 1.3.2: first widescreen patch
body: Your shots now land where the crosshair is, light glows sit on the lamps again and the restored Gothic tile set finally has its real name. Works for USA and PAL, just press Update.

title: Crystal Cut 1.3.1 brings automatic updates back
body: Everyone on 1.2.x or 1.3.0 can update straight from the launcher again. Same content as 1.3.0, your saves and settings are kept.

title: Crystal Cut 1.3.0 is out
body: The restored edition. MapMaker Story co-op on PS2 for the first time, cut characters back in the story, 9 new Arcade maps, One on One, 25 extra characters, 128 MB, USA and PAL as one game. Everything restored is on by default and can be switched off.

title: Devlog: hidden content is coming back
body: The Consultant is playable, Dam and Wild West are back in Arcade, hidden weapons and the cut Gothic MapMaker tiles are in. Works with your normal disc, USA and PAL.

title: Devlog - one download for both discs
body: The PAL version is now part of the port. One download works with the USA and the European disc, both play the same and can meet online. Plus rumble, number keys for weapons and a lot of fixes.

title: Devlog - coming in 1.2.2
body: MapMaker walls are back, controller zoom is fixed, new low stimulus options and a first look at the PAL version. What is done and what is still open before 1.2.2.

title: Version 1.2.1 - better updates
body: The launcher now asks before it updates, shows every step with progress and tells you when you can play.

title: Devlog - 1.2 is out, what comes next
body: How the double image got fixed, what we test before every release and what we are working on for the next update.

title: Version 1.2 - patch notes
body: Clearer picture at high resolutions, scope weapons fixed, mouse speed follows the zoom, Temporal Uplink map fixed, optional cheats, Steam Deck launcher, safer Windows setup.

title: Devlog - where 1.1.1 stands
body: Update 1.1.1 is taking longer than planned. What is already fixed, what comes after it and what we are working on right now.

title: Update 1.1.1 takes a little longer
body: In the last round of testing we found a few new bugs. We want to fix them before 1.1.1 goes out, so you get an update that really works.

title: Coming soon: update 1.1.1
body: A quick fix update is almost ready. Weapons with the mouse, optional cheats, Online+ fixes, a second try for the Windows setup and the launcher on the Steam Deck.

title: Weapons with mouse aiming - we are working on a fix
body: Some weapons do not behave right with mouse aiming in 1.1.0, most of all the two sniper rifles. We are working on the fix as fast as possible. It will come through the launcher.

title: Version 1.1.0 is out - patch notes
body: New launcher with automatic updates and news, fog, snow, smoke and debris like the original, a picture that fits any screen, rebuilt mouse aiming. If you are on 1.0.x, download 1.1 once by hand - after that the launcher updates the game for you.

title: Devlog - the road to 1.1
body: What happened between 1.0.1 and 1.1. A wrong sine in the VU1, a new launcher, a Windows test lab, mouse aiming, Online+, and the things we got wrong on the way.

title: Bug fixes and updates - 1.1 is on the way
body: Everything since 1.0.1 in one list. The German launcher on Windows, the black bars and the grey smoke wall are fixed, and there is a new launcher, mouse aiming, Online+, texture packs and more. Sorry for the German!

title: What's new in 1.1, and what's still in testing
body: A new launcher with automatic updates, proper 16:9 menus and HUD, mouse aiming, a clearer sniper scope and online play. Here's what's done and what's still being tested.

title: Online+ - a first look
body: Online+ is an optional second edition with its own lobby, server browser, ranks, killfeed and scoreboard. Everything sits in the game's own menus. The classic game and its multiplayer stay untouched.
